text:
Evan (AE): OrchID Therapeutics POC moving fast. Customer demands PO-first flow and wants the order form + DPA signed this week. They flagged two things: EU data residency and narrower indemnity. Can we map signers and acceptable redlines?
Maya (Sales Ops): Do we have OF_final? I see OF_7_net30 and OF_7_prepay. Which to attach?
Evan (AE): They agreed net30 in email, procurement insists PO before invoice. PO contact: procure@orchidtx.com.
Ravi (Legal): Quick check: are they requesting SCCs or any custom audit rights? That changes DPA scope.
Evan (AE): Security contact says: "SCCs not required, but data must stay in eu-west-1, prefer KMS with HSM option. Indemnity needs to be capped."
Sofia (Solutions): If we guarantee region residency with hosted private variant, SLA for latency tightens. That implies Dedicated commitment and possibly a runbook addendum. Pricing needs to confirm uplift.
Maya (Sales Ops): I'll draft DocuSign envelope: procurement stamp -> accounts -> exec optional. Do we allow procurement-only stamp if DPA redline matches?
Ravi (Legal): Uploading redline: key points: add eu-residency clause, KMS scoping with optional HSM statement, cap indemnity to contract value, and limit audit to remote reviews with 7 days notice. Also propose PO threshold: if PO <= $175k, procurement stamp allowed; above that require exec signature.
InvoiceBot (billing-bot): Draft invoice ready: https://billing.redwood.internal/drafts/ORCH-2026-34 (internal)
Evan (AE): Procurement signer is "Oliver P (Procurement)". They want PO printed on DocuSign and invoice emailed to ap@orchidtx.com.
Maya (Sales Ops): Which order form to attach? OF_7_net30 then. I will prefill PO: ORCH-PO-2026-34 and link invoice draft.
Sofia (Solutions): Note on HSM: provisioning lead time ~7 days for HSM-backed KMS. If customer accepts KMS-only we can waive lead time. That affects go-live dates in order form.
Ravi (Legal): Clarify indemnity cap: cap = fees for contract period. Will accept for POCs up to $175k. Anything above, escalate to exec for approval.
Maya (Sales Ops): Envelope sent to procurement. ETA 24-36h. Tagging exec as signer 2 but optional.
Evan (AE): I'll follow up with Oliver to request 12h turnaround. Can you flag escalation if no sign in 10h?
Maya (Sales Ops): Will escalate to procurement lead and AE ping after 10h.
InvoiceBot (billing-bot): Reminder queued: invoice to be sent upon completed signature.
Sofia (Solutions): Pricing note: Dedicated/private addon + HSM option = estimated +35% on monthly. Please confirm pricing approval before we commit.
Ravi (Legal): If procurement stamps and PO <= $175k, no exec required. I'll monitor and be ready to route for exec sign if they push for higher indemnity.
Evan (AE): Thanks team. Plan: Maya to send OF_7_net30 + DPA redline, attach PO and invoice link. Ravi will monitor redline acceptance. Sofia to confirm final uplift to pricing. I'll chase procurement.
